book.name: Daidas
book.title: Daidas Pol Daidas nɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Krais nɨbi bɨ kale aige göl gɨnaböl
Krais nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp hagmön, kiŋ gau abe, gapman bɨ kub gau abe manö hagöl rö nöp göl. Pör nöp nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau kalɨp gɨ aij göl rö lɨnɨm u, kalɨp gɨ aij göl.
Pen nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau kalɨp manö piral haglö hib kale lugagnɨm; pen pen hagagöm, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gau hag ud aij göm, nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö aip nɨbi bɨ hain mɨd aij göm, göl.

Pen nɨhön: hon ke nöd u rö nöp gasɨ nɨŋ aij gagun, God Manö hagöp rö jɨ nɨŋun, hañ romaŋ hon ke gasɨ göp rö nöp gun a gun, bɨ nagɨman rö mɨdmɨdun. Hon nan si nan naij nöp göl gɨ mɨdmɨdun; nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp gasɨ naij nɨŋun, nan kale gau nan hon rö mɨdaiböp, a gun, kalɨp pen nɨŋno mulu lugö pen nɨŋlö mulu lugö gɨmɨdun. Pen jɨ nɨŋlö pen jɨ nɨŋun gɨmɨdun.
Nöd anɨg gɨmɨdun u pen hainö God, Ud Kamɨŋ Yuep Bɨ hon u, God nɨbi bɨ mög nɨŋöm mɨdmagö löp u hanɨp nɨbi bɨ waiö la.

God nɨpe hanɨp ud Kamɨŋ yua. Hanɨp ud Kamɨŋ yua u, hon ke nan aij rɨmnap gɨno hanɨp ud Kamɨŋ yuaga. Nɨpe hanɨp mög yabɨƚ nɨŋöb u me, hanɨp ud Kamɨŋ yua. Ga anɨbu, Ana Uɫ u hanɨp yuö apöm, gac hon u ƚɨk gɨ yuö, nɨbi bɨ hain nɨbö yabɨƚ lɨbun.
God nɨpe Ana Uɫ hanɨp böŋ nöp yuö apöm hanɨp aŋ daŋ mɨdöp u, Jisas Krais hanɨp nan a göm umöm ud Kamɨŋ yua u me, anɨg ga.
God ga anɨbu, hanɨp mög nɨŋöm nɨbi bɨ Kamɨŋ aij nɨpe rö udöm, Kamɨŋ pör mɨdep u udun a gɨpun u, hanɨp ñɨnabin, a göm ga.

Manö nɨŋö yabɨƚ me anɨbu. Manö hagajɨn anɨbu nɨŋ aij gɨmön kƚö gɨmön hag ñɨmön, God nɨp nɨŋ udpal nɨbi bɨ gau gasɨ añɨ anɨbu nöp nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap kalɨp gɨ aij göl gɨ mɨdaiöl. Anɨg gɨnaböl u gɨ aij yabɨƚ gɨnaböl. Manö anɨbi manö aij yabɨƚ; ram mɨnöŋ gau gau ud arlö, hagöp rö nöp geinaböl u, nɨbi bɨ magöŋhalö agamɨj mɨd aij gɨnaböl.

Pen nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap manö haƚöwaƚö hag amɨl apɨl göm, apɨs bac hon gau anɨg anɨg göl rɨklö auöp, a göm, Juda lo manö u anɨg anɨg göl mɨdöp, a göm, pen pen hagaiöl u, ne aip hagagmön. Manö anɨb gau iƚ ap mɨdagöp; nɨbi bɨ manö yɨharɨŋ anɨbu nɨŋöm agamɨj mɨd aij göl rö lagöp.
Anɨb u, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap God Manö kabö göl u arö göm, manö rɨmnap ke hagaiöl, mañ añɨ ap hagmön. Pen nɨŋagaiöl, mañu u rö nöp hagmön. Mañu u rö nöp nɨŋagaiöl, kalɨp böŋ nöp arö gɨmön.
Ne nɨŋban, nɨbi bɨ anɨg gɨpal gau kale gasɨ naij nöp nɨŋöm, nan si nan naij nöp göl gɨ mɨdlö, gasɨ mɨdmagö aŋ kale daŋ gac mɨdöp u waiö lö nɨŋbun.
Yad hainö Ademas aka Dijikas hag yunö, nöp am hagö, ne yɨŋɨd auep rö lainɨm yɨŋɨd Nikopolis daun aumön. Yɨbaud göm yɨgön gɨnab ñɨn u yad am mɨdeinabin ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu.
Bɨ ne Sinas lo manö nɨŋöb u aip, bɨ ne Apolos aip, kalɨp ud aij gɨmön, adan arnɨg gaimil u, nan kale rɨmnap mɨdagainɨm ñɨmön ud armil.
Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe Krir mɨdpal gau, kale wög göl gɨ mɨdlö nan ñɨŋeb pɨlnɨm. Kale kƚö göm pör nöp gɨ aij göl gɨ mɨdöm, wög göl gɨ mɨdöm, nan magö ñɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ nan mɨdagöp gau kalɨp rɨmnap ñɨnaböl.
Daidas. Nɨbi bɨ yad aip mɨdpun aui nöp, “Mɨdpan?” a gɨpal. Pen hon Krais manö aij nɨŋ udpun rö nɨŋ udöm, hanɨp mɨdmagö lɨbal gau kalɨp, “Mɨdpim?” a gɨmön. God kalöp magöŋhalö mög nɨŋöm abad mɨdainɨm.
